name: Wly_timerTrackMasks
note: sequence track masks indexed by RPWlyTimerSe::mMaskIdx (SetTrackVolume on / ~mask off)

name: Wly_avatarVoiceLabels
note: second voice id per voice kind and Wly_fieldIndex; RPWlySoundActor::PlayVoice (Wly_playAvatarVoice)

name: Wly_avatarVoiceIds
note: first voice id per voice kind and Wly_fieldIndex, played for player 1 or 2; RPWlySoundActor::PlayVoice

name: Wly_bgmIds
note: stage BGM per Wly_fieldIndex; RPWlySoundObj PlayBgm (Wly_SoundObj_playBgm)

name: Wly_defaultLevelData
note: copied over every level record when Wly_levelTableOverride is set (RPWlyLevelTable constructor)

name: Wly_debugHitScale
note: scale of RPWlyAvatar::mScale for the debug hit area (Wly_Avatar_drawDebugHitArea)

name: Wly_hitOffsetY
note: avatar hit area offset; RPWlyAvatarMgr::FindAvatarUnderCursor / FindAvatarNearCursor

name: Wly_hitScale
note: avatar hit area size per RPWlyAvatar::mScale; FindAvatarUnderCursor / FindAvatarNearCursor

name: Wly_dpdParam0
note: first argument of the controller's slot 0x10 (pointer setting) in RPWlyGameMgr::Init

name: Wly_dpdParam1
note: second argument of the controller's slot 0x10 in RPWlyGameMgr::Init

name: Wly_avatarSpacing
note: 7.5 on field type 1 else 5.0 (RPWlyStage constructor); used by the placement patterns

name: Wly_timeFormat
note: L"%d"-style format of RPWlyTimerLyt (swprintf of the seconds)

name: Wly_scoreFormat
note: format of RPWlyDisplayLyt::SetPlayerScore

name: Wly_layoutSetInstance
note: RPWlyLayoutSet::CreateInstance

name: Wly_avatarMgrInstance
note: RPWlyAvatarMgr::CreateInstance

name: Wly_gameMgrInstance
note: RPWlyGameMgr::CreateInstance

name: Wly_isMultiPlayer
note: player count != 1, set by the RPWlyGameMgr constructor on the first stage

name: Wly_timeUpLock
note: checked == 0 with state 2 and a negative timer in RPWlyGameMgr::Calculate

name: Wly_fieldIndex
note: 0-9 by field type and spotlight flag, set by RPWlyField::Create; indexes the BGM and voice tables

name: Wly_roundSoundActive
note: set by RPWlyTimerSe::StartRoundSound, cleared by Init/Reset/Update

name: Wly_levelTableInstance
note: RPWlyLevelTable::CreateInstance

name: Wly_levelTableOverride
note: non-zero: every level record is replaced by Wly_defaultLevelData (debug)
